source_claim: Hasbro's official Transformers character bios identify Optimus Prime (G1), Starscream (G1), Megatron (G2), Arcee (Prime), and Tarn (Comic) as Transformers characters. Each checked profile names the character, faction, and/or origin universe.
notes: Additional checked official Hasbro bios: https://transformers-bios.hasbro.com/en-us/starscream-g1-decepticon (G1 Starscream); https://transformers-bios.hasbro.com/en-us/megatron-g2-decepticon (G2 Megatron); https://transformers-bios.hasbro.com/en-us/arcee-autobot (Prime Arcee); https://transformers-bios.hasbro.com/en-us/tarn-decepticon (Comic Tarn). This is a partial source collection for the broad multigenerational campaign; no continuity-wide inference is made for its other members.
